The '''Ulgo Siegebreaker''' was a massively powerful [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that was part of [[House Ulgo]]'s forces. It patrolled the western end of the [[Glarus Valley]], in the riverbed, during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].
